name: FusedInferAttentionScore

query.description: query tensor for inference attention, dtype float16

key.description: key tensor for inference attention, dtype float16

value.description: value tensor for inference attention, dtype float16

atten_mask.description: Tensor, optional; attention mask, dtype bool/int8/uint8

actual_seq_lengths.description: List[int], optional; valid sequence length per batch for query

actual_seq_lengths_kv.description: List[int], optional; valid sequence length per batch for key/value

dequant_scale1.description: Tensor, optional; BMM1 dequantization factor, dtype uint64/float32

quant_scale1.description: Tensor, optional; BMM2 quantization factor, dtype float32

dequant_scale2.description: Tensor, optional; BMM2 dequantization factor, dtype uint64/float32

quant_scale2.description: Tensor, optional; output quantization factor, dtype float32/bfloat16

quant_offset2.description: Tensor, optional; output quantization offset, dtype float32/bfloat16

antiquant_scale.description: Tensor, optional; anti-quantization scale, dtype float16/bfloat16

antiquant_offset.description: Tensor, optional; anti-quantization offset, dtype float16/bfloat16

block_table.description: Tensor, optional; PageAttention block mapping table, dtype int32

query_padding_size.description: Tensor, optional; query right-alignment padding info, dtype int64

kv_padding_size.description: Tensor, optional; key/value right-alignment padding info, dtype int64

key_shared_prefix.description: Tensor, optional; key shared prefix cache

value_shared_prefix.description: Tensor, optional; value shared prefix cache

actual_shared_prefix_len.description: List[int], optional; shared prefix valid sequence length

query_rope.description: Tensor, optional; query rotary position embedding for MLA

key_rope.description: Tensor, optional; key rotary position embedding for MLA

key_rope_antiquant_scale.description: Tensor, optional; reserved parameter for key rope anti-quantization

pre_tokens.description: int, default=2147483647; forward token count for sparse attention

next_tokens.description: int, default=2147483647; backward token count for sparse attention

softmax_lse_flag.description: bool, default=False; whether to output softmax log-sum-exp

description:
Model that performs fused inference attention score computation using NPU accelerated npu_fused_infer_attention_score.
Supports both prompt (full) and incremental inference scenarios for FlashAttention.

Torch native implementation (equivalent to npu_fused_infer_attention_score for standard MHA path):
import torch

def run(query, key, value, pse_shift=None, atten_mask=None, actual_seq_lengths=None, actual_seq_lengths_kv=None, dequant_scale1=None, quant_scale1=None, dequant_scale2=None, quant_scale2=None, quant_offset2=None, antiquant_scale=None, antiquant_offset=None, block_table=None, query_padding_size=None, kv_padding_size=None, key_antiquant_scale=None, key_antiquant_offset=None, value_antiquant_scale=None, value_antiquant_offset=None, key_shared_prefix=None, value_shared_prefix=None, actual_shared_prefix_len=None, query_rope=None, key_rope=None, key_rope_antiquant_scale=None, num_heads=1, scale=1.0, pre_tokens=2147483647, next_tokens=2147483647, input_layout='BSH', num_key_value_heads=0, sparse_mode=0, inner_precise=0, block_size=0, antiquant_mode=0, softmax_lse_flag=False, key_antiquant_mode=0, value_antiquant_mode=0):
    kv_heads = num_key_value_heads if num_key_value_heads else num_heads

    if input_layout == "BSH":
        batch_size, seq_len, hidden = query.shape
        _, seq_len_kv, _ = key.shape
        head_dim = hidden // num_heads
        q = query.view(batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        k = key.view(batch_size, seq_len_kv, kv_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        v = value.view(batch_size, seq_len_kv, kv_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    elif input_layout == "BSND":
        batch_size, seq_len, n_q, head_dim = query.shape
        _, seq_len_kv, n_kv, _ = key.shape
        q = query.transpose(1, 2)
        k = key.transpose(1, 2)
        v = value.transpose(1, 2)
    elif input_layout == "BNSD":
        q, k, v = query, key, value
        batch_size = q.shape[0]
        seq_len = q.shape[2]
        seq_len_kv = k.shape[2]
        head_dim = q.shape[-1]
    else:
        raise NotImplementedError(f"Layout {input_layout} not supported")

    if kv_heads != num_heads:
        n_rep = num_heads // kv_heads
        k = k.repeat_interleave(n_rep, dim=1)
        v = v.repeat_interleave(n_rep, dim=1)

    scores = torch.matmul(q.float(), k.float().transpose(-2, -1)) * scale

    i = torch.arange(seq_len, device=q.device).unsqueeze(1)
    j = torch.arange(seq_len_kv, device=q.device).unsqueeze(0)
    if sparse_mode == 4:
        pre = pre_tokens if (pre_tokens is not None and pre_tokens != 2147483647) else seq_len
        nxt = next_tokens if (next_tokens is not None and next_tokens != 2147483647) else seq_len_kv
        band = (j > (i + nxt)) | (j < (i - pre))
        scores = scores.masked_fill(band.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0), float('-inf'))
    elif atten_mask is not None:
        if atten_mask.dim() == 2:
            am = atten_mask[:seq_len, :seq_len_kv]
        elif atten_mask.dim() == 3:
            am = atten_mask[:, :seq_len, :seq_len_kv]
        else:
            am = atten_mask
        if atten_mask.dtype == torch.bool:
            scores = scores.masked_fill(am, float('-inf'))
        else:
            scores = scores + am.float()
    else:
        if sparse_mode == 2:
            causal = j > i
            scores = scores.masked_fill(causal.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0), float('-inf'))
        elif sparse_mode == 3:
            offset = seq_len_kv - seq_len
            causal = j > (i + offset)
            scores = scores.masked_fill(causal.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0), float('-inf'))

    attn_weights = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    out = torch.matmul(attn_weights, v.float())

    if input_layout in ("BSH", "BSND"):
        out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()
        if input_layout == "BSH":
            out = out.view(batch_size, seq_len, -1)
        else:
            out = out.view(batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim)
    elif input_layout == "BNSD":
        out = out

    out = out.to(query.dtype)
    return out, torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.float32, device=out.device)
